Purpose and link to strategy:
Attract and retain high calibre individuals
to deliver the Company’s strategic plans by
offering market competitive remuneration to
reflect an individual’s skills and experience.
Mechanics of reward:
- Paid in 12 equal monthly instalments
during the year and is pensionable.
- Reviewed annually with salary
changes effective from April depending
on performance.

Purpose and link to strategy:
Provide competitive post-retirement benefit
arrangements so as to attract and retain high
calibre talent to drive delivery of strategy.
Mechanics of reward:
Annual contribution up to the 10% of
basic salary.

Purpose and link to strategy:
Provide market competitive benefits which:
- facilitate the attraction and retention of high
calibre talent to deliver the Group’s strategic
plans; and
- recognise that such talent is global in source
and that the availability of certain benefits are
key enablers for attraction and retention.
Mechanics of reward:
Range of benefits include:
- Housing allowance
- Transport allowance
- Medical insurance
- Personal life and accident insurance

Purpose and link to strategy:
Incentivise the attainment of corporate targets
aligned to the strategic objectives of the Group
on an annual basis.
Mechanics of reward:
- Payout is done annually in April after
measurements and approval of results.
- 100% of the bonus is paid in cash.
- Payout is 25% of annual Salary for
Managing Director and 15% for Finance
Director
Performance metrics:
Targets are set annually
based on the group and
company business plans.
